_comment: deckbridge: Claude Code hook wiring for Stream Deck keys 5-9.
Merge the 'hooks' block below into ~/.claude/settings.json (user-wide) or a
project .claude/settings.json.  Replace REPLACE_ME with the absolute path to
Every entry runs the SAME script; the shim decides the deck status from the
hook_event_name field Claude Code puts on stdin.
Labels are prefixed cc- so a Claude and a Codex session in the same folder
occupy two keys instead of overwriting one record.
Optional flags: --ttl 900   (seconds before a dead agent ages off the deck)
Never add --print here: hook stdout is parsed by the agent.
